title: Glacier Bay Constructor 2-Handle Tub and Shower Faucet, Brushed Nickel (Valve Included)

comparisons.notes: Glacier Bay Constructor HD833CX-0004 brushed nickel, valve included

writeup: Glacier Bay's Constructor tub and shower faucet in brushed nickel is a two-handle, single-spray set with a solid brass valve body, ceramic disc cartridges, a diverter tub spout and a 1.8 GPM WaterSense showerhead, valve included. Home Depot sells this brushed nickel version for $78.
